title: MineDex S3
description: Join the ultimate Cobblemon server! Experience Pokémon fusions, every battle gimmick (Megas, Tera, Z-Moves), legendary structures, and competitive tournaments.
body:
🌟 Welcome to Minedex!
The Ultimate Cobblemon Server & Modpack Experience

Step into Minedex, a meticulously crafted Cobblemon modpack designed to bring the most feature-complete and thrilling Pokémon adventure to Minecraft. Whether you are an explorer hunting for rare variants, a collector looking to trade, or a hardcore battler ready to fine-tune your competitive team for the next big tournament, Minedex has a place for you!

⚔️ Next-Level Battle Mechanics
We bring the full depth of Pokémon battling right into Minecraft. Build your ultimate competitive team with access to all your favorite generational gimmicks!

All Battle Gimmicks: Unleash the power of Mega Evolution, Terastallization, Z-Moves, and Dynamax/Gigantamax (G/D Max).

Legends Z-A Megas: Get ahead of the curve with exclusive Mega Evolutions inspired by the upcoming Legends: Z-A!

Pokémon Fusion: Combine your favorite partners to create entirely new, powerful fusions.

TMs & TRs: Fully customize your team's movesets for maximum strategic depth.

🗺️ Epic Exploration & Rare Encounters
The world of Minedex is alive and waiting to be explored.

Legendary Structures: Legendary Pokémon aren't just random spawns; discover them lurking inside uniquely designed, custom structures hidden throughout the world.

Expanded Roster: Encounter extra Paradox Pokémon that break the boundaries of time.

Unique Shiny Variants: Hunt down dazzling, custom Shiny variants you won't find anywhere else.

🏆 The Competitive Journey
Prove you are the very best. Our server is built with competitive team building and challenging progression in mind.

The Gym Challenge: Test your skills against a mix of challenging NPC Gym Leaders and formidable Player-run Gyms.

The Battle Tower: Take on relentless waves of trainers in the Battle Tower to prove your mastery and earn high-tier rewards.

Competitive Tournaments: Clash with rival trainers in organized, high-stakes tournaments.

Exclusive Trophies: Win different tournaments and proudly display unique, custom trophies to show off your victories to the server!

🤝 Thriving Community & Server Features
Minedex isn't just a modpack; it's a home for Pokémon fans.

Beautiful Lobby: Spawn into a highly detailed, welcoming lobby to kickstart your journey.

Active Marketplace: Engage in a bustling player economy to buy, sell, and trade Pokémon and items with ease.

Friendly & Dedicated Staff: Our active support team is always around to ensure smooth gameplay, host events, and help you out.

Download the modpack, join the server, and start your Minedex journey today!
